_comment: VFR ground chatter — startup, taxi, radio checks, and minor non-routine events (blocked calls, read-back corrections, cautions). Generic taxi phrasing only (no computed routes for other traffic). Nothing major — no emergencies. Edit freely or drop in your own *.json next to this one.
